ApiStatus.description: Body of the example contract route.

BlockingDomainControlRef.description:
The blocking E8 policy snapshot. Changing this requires an explicit Emumet
domain-controls update; a post operation or reveal never unblocks implicitly.

revision.description: The same E8 int64 monotonic revision, never minted by ShuttlePub.

ContentNotificationsResponse.description:
Only visible notifications contribute to unread_count. No hidden marker,
count, explanation or push/history recall guarantee is exposed here.

ContentPageInfo.description:
S8 collection cursor only. Closed metadata prevents hidden-count/annotation
extensions; opaque cursors must not disclose suppressed identities or counts.

ContentRestriction.description:
Independent content gates. Reveal does not clear CW/sensitive, deletion or
viewing permission. A restricted response carries no gated content.

ControlDomain.description:
E8 DomainControlResponse.domain, not a second normalizer. Already normalized
lowercase ASCII/IDNA A-label host; UTS #46 non-transitional; remove one trailing
dot. Exact match: example.com does not include sub.example.com. E8 rejects
invalid inputs with 422. Match only Emumet D8P ControlDomain::from_actor_id's
verified canonical actor-ID host, never display acct, username or asserted domain.

DirectItem.description:
Explicitly revealed item. Boost-wrapper direct reveal is undecided and not
part of S8 (the original note URL uses ordinary single-note reveal).
Operations concern its own author/target, NOT the
domain of an embedded quote. The unblocked quoter remains actionable.

DirectNoteResponse.description:
Profile scoped direct view. Initial GET is hidden for a controlled domain.
POST reveal is explicit and applies only to this note in the current page.
Never persist or sync reveal, never change E8 revision. Hide discards the
page-local result; reload/revisit uses GET and hides again. Reveal never
changes another note, embedded content, block, CW/sensitive or viewing rights.

DomainBlockMode.description: Block-only projection of E8 mode; not an additional policy mode.

DomainControlMode.description:
E8 DomainControlMode, verbatim: mute suppresses display only; block also
refuses new operations in both directions. Never a new ShuttlePub setting.

DomainControlRef.description:
Immutable observation of E8 DomainControlResponse, not a local policy copy.
No created_at/updated_at needed for content presentation.

profile_id.description:
E8 profile_id (Profile nanoid); same value as path profile_nanoid and
ProfileResponse.id. Never Account ID, actor URL or nullable username.

revision.description:
E8 int64 revision, starts at 1. Create/replace/delete/recreate advance it;
tombstones prevent reuse. Not S3 settings revision or a reveal revision.

DomainOperationPermission.description:
Domain-only operation permission; allowed does not bypass D13 or any other
permission. Mute adds no operation restriction. Block is not cleared by reveal.

EmbeddedNotePresentation.description:
One embedded target only. Revealing an outer quote never reveals
this target. No decision about attribution through nested quotes is made.

revision.description: E8 revision, starts at 1, monotonically increases, never reused.

EmojiAvailability.description: Whether an emoji can currently be used.

EmojiReactionDomainBlock.description:
Per-operation emoji_reaction block refusal details. Explicit unblock in Emumet is
required first; mute never produces this result. D13 cannot override block.

EmojiReactionOperation.description: Operation identity, distinct on the wire from every other post action.

EmojiRef.description:
Identity of an emoji. Two references are the same emoji when they are equal
as JSON values, which is why this type carries no display data.

oneOf.description: A Unicode emoji, identified by its code point sequence.

value.description:
The fully qualified emoji sequence, for example `👍` or `👨‍👩‍👧‍👦`.
At most 32 code points, no Unicode White_Space or control characters
and at least one non-ASCII code point; the pattern spells out exactly
the characters the server rejects (the exact emoji set is checked by
the server; skin tones and ZWJ sequences are distinct emoji).

oneOf.description:
A custom emoji, identified by the server's stable emoji identifier.
The identifier survives deletion, so an unavailable emoji keeps its
identity.

id.description: Stable identifier of the custom emoji (not the shortcode).

EmojiView.description: An emoji as returned by the server: identity plus availability and display data.

availability.description: Current availability. Unicode emoji are always `available`.

image_url.description:
Image of a custom emoji when one is still served; absent for Unicode
emoji and for deleted custom emoji.

shortcode.description: Display shortcode of a custom emoji, without colons; absent for Unicode emoji.

ErrorBody.description:
Structured error body returned by `/api/v1` handlers for every error they report.

Responses produced by the framework itself (unmatched route, wrong method)
do not go through a handler and therefore do not use this body.

code.description: Stable machine readable code; clients should branch on this value.

oneOf.description:
Optional S8 outbound block refusal. code remains forbidden (403); absent
for all existing S0/S3 errors. No mutation, implicit unblock or Undo.

message.description: Human readable description intended for developers, not end users.

ErrorCode.description: Machine readable error code carried by every error body.

FeedItem.description:
A feed contains only visible items. For mute AND block, omit an entire
third-party quote (including the quoter's comment) or pure repost when its
immediate target is suppressed. Do not mute/block that third party or their
unrelated posts. No hidden variant, placeholder, suppressed count or note.

FieldViolation.description: A single field level validation problem.

field.description: Name or JSON pointer of the offending field.

InboundEmojiReactionRejection.description:
ShuttlePub INTERNAL inbound emoji_reaction acceptance result contract, NOT a wire
inbox/API or an ActivityPub HTTP status. Refuse NEW actions from this domain
to this Profile, even if D13 permits the action. No rejection on mute alone.

InboundLikeRejection.description:
ShuttlePub INTERNAL inbound like acceptance result contract, NOT a wire
inbox/API or an ActivityPub HTTP status. Refuse NEW actions from this domain
to this Profile, even if D13 permits the action. No rejection on mute alone.

InboundQuoteRejection.description:
ShuttlePub INTERNAL inbound quote acceptance result contract, NOT a wire
inbox/API or an ActivityPub HTTP status. Refuse NEW actions from this domain
to this Profile, even if D13 permits the action. No rejection on mute alone.

InboundReplyRejection.description:
ShuttlePub INTERNAL inbound reply acceptance result contract, NOT a wire
inbox/API or an ActivityPub HTTP status. Refuse NEW actions from this domain
to this Profile, even if D13 permits the action. No rejection on mute alone.

InboundRepostRejection.description:
ShuttlePub INTERNAL inbound repost acceptance result contract, NOT a wire
inbox/API or an ActivityPub HTTP status. Refuse NEW actions from this domain
to this Profile, even if D13 permits the action. No rejection on mute alone.

LikeDomainBlock.description:
Per-operation like block refusal details. Explicit unblock in Emumet is
required first; mute never produces this result. D13 cannot override block.

LikeOperation.description: Operation identity, distinct on the wire from every other post action.

NoteContent.description: Minimal content projection for this contract, not a full author/media DTO.

NotePresentation.description:
Direct URL presentation. Hidden contains ONLY state, E8 mode, domain and
revision: no body, author details, media, CW text, mention or embedded data.
Restricted remains content-free even after an explicit single-note reveal.

revision.description: E8 revision, not a session/reveal token.

NoteSearchResponse.description: Post search only (not Account search). No suppression annotation or count.

PageInfo.description: Pagination metadata embedded in collection responses.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

PageParams.description: Query parameters for cursor paginated collections.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor taken from a previous `next_cursor`.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return; the server picks a default when omitted.

PostComment.description: Reply/quote input only; success-creation semantics are outside S8.

ProfileNanoid.description: Public identifier of a posting Profile (Emumet's `profile_nanoid`).

PutReaction.description: Request body selecting the reaction of a Profile on a Note.

emoji.description: The emoji to select; replaces any previous selection.

QuickReactionSettings.description: Quick reaction settings of a Profile.

favorites.description: Ordered favourites, at most 5 and pairwise distinct by `emoji`. Unavailable favourites are kept and flagged, never removed silently.

revision.description:
Monotonic revision, `0` for a Profile that never saved settings. It
increases by one whenever the stored favourites change.

QuoteDomainBlock.description:
Per-operation quote block refusal details. Explicit unblock in Emumet is
required first; mute never produces this result. D13 cannot override block.

QuoteOperation.description: Operation identity, distinct on the wire from every other post action.

ReactionCounts.description:
Accepted historical likes/emoji remain counted after block; rejected new
operations add nothing. No automatic deletion or Undo, no block annotation.
Independent legitimate removal can still change counts.

ReactionState.description: The reaction a Profile has on a Note.

oneOf.description:
The selected emoji, or `null` when the Profile has not reacted. The
emoji may be `unavailable`; it can still be removed.

note_id.description: The Note the reaction belongs to.

RejectedOutcome.description: Internal acceptance decision, not an ActivityPub inbox wire response.

ReplyDomainBlock.description:
Per-operation reply block refusal details. Explicit unblock in Emumet is
required first; mute never produces this result. D13 cannot override block.

ReplyOperation.description: Operation identity, distinct on the wire from every other post action.

RepostDomainBlock.description:
Per-operation repost block refusal details. Explicit unblock in Emumet is
required first; mute never produces this result. D13 cannot override block.

RepostOperation.description: Operation identity, distinct on the wire from every other post action.

RevisionConflictBody.description:
`409` body for a stale `expected_revision`: the common `ErrorBody` fields
with `code` fixed to `revision_conflict`, plus the stored revision.

current_revision.description: The revision currently stored; refetch the settings and retry.

message.description: Human readable description intended for developers, not end users.

TimelineResponse.description: Profile-scoped timeline: suppressed items leave no trace, including counts.

UpdateQuickReactionSettings.description: Request body replacing the favourites of a Profile.

expected_revision.description: The revision the client last saw. Use `0` for the first save.

favorites.description: The complete new ordered list: 0..=5 pairwise distinct emoji. An empty list clears the favourites.

bearer_auth.description: Bearer access token of the signed-in user. The caller must be allowed to act as the Profile in the path.

delete.description:
Idempotent and independent of emoji availability: answers `200` with
`emoji: null` also when nothing was selected, and also when the selected
emoji has become unavailable.

200.description: Unreacted state (emoji null), including a repeated delete. Contract only: never returned while the endpoint is a stub

403.description: The caller may not act as this Profile (forbidden)

404.description: Unknown Profile or Note (not_found); never because no reaction exists

delete.summary: Remove the reaction of a Profile on a Note (stub: always answers 501)

200.description: Selected emoji, or emoji null when not reacted. Contract only: never returned while the endpoint is a stub

403.description: The caller may not act as this Profile (forbidden)

get.summary: Get the reaction of a Profile on a Note (stub: always answers 501)

put.description:
Idempotent: repeating the same emoji returns `200` with the same state. A
different emoji replaces the previous one (1 Profile, 1 Note, 1 reaction).
Availability is checked first: an unavailable emoji is always `422`, even
when it is the emoji already selected (the selection then stays, and can be
removed with `DELETE`).

200.description: State after selecting (also for a repeated or replacing request). Contract only: never returned while the endpoint is a stub

400.description: Malformed emoji identifier or profile_nanoid (invalid_request with details)

403.description: Forbidden: caller may not act as Profile, or E8 domain block refuses the new emoji operation. Block uses optional ErrorBody.domain_block (EmojiReactionDomainBlock); explicit unblock required first. Mute adds no restriction. Existing S3 error shape remains valid.

422.description: The emoji is unavailable (emoji_unavailable), checked before the repeat no-op rule; the current reaction stays

put.description:
Full replacement guarded by `expected_revision`. Idempotent retry: when
`favorites` equal the stored list the stored settings are returned with
`200` and the revision is unchanged, whatever `expected_revision` is.
Otherwise a revision mismatch is `409 revision_conflict`.

200.description: Stored settings after the update (new revision), or unchanged settings for an idempotent retry. Contract only: never returned while the endpoint is a stub

400.description: More than 5 favorites, duplicates, malformed emoji identifiers or profile_nanoid (invalid_request with details)

403.description: The caller may not act as this Profile (forbidden)

409.description: expected_revision is stale (revision_conflict); current_revision tells the stored revision

422.description: A newly added emoji is unavailable (emoji_unavailable); favorites already stored may stay (details point at the offending /favorites/{index})
